recommendation: Safe recovery workflow for a contractor account: 1) Verify the requester’s employee ID against authoritative records. 2) Obtain manager confirmation before any recovery action. 3) Confirm the request scope and the specific contractor account affected. 4) Use the minimum necessary recovery steps to restore access, documenting each action and the approver identity. 5) Complete the recovery within the 8-hour SLA when possible, or escalate if the deadline is at risk. 6) As a defense-in-depth improvement, optionally seek an independent sponsor confirmation when available, but do not treat it as required by the current policy.
quality_notes: This workflow follows the visible policy by requiring employee ID and manager confirmation.
Independent sponsor confirmation is included only as a recommended defense-in-depth measure, not as a policy requirement.
The recommendation preserves the provided baseline summary without altering it.
The workflow is framed for a contractor account and references the 8-hour SLA.
